clos.original_description: Pre-process data and set up a pre-trained neural network.
clos.enriched_description: Pre-process medical imaging data and set up a pre-trained neural network for medical diagnosis tasks. The scope includes computer vision applications for disease detection, handling class imbalance and small training sets, image pre-processing, weighted loss functions, DenseNet, patient overlap checks, and chest X-ray diagnosis with deep learning.

clos.original_description: Evaluate models by accuracy, specificity, predictive value, confidence intervals, ROC curve, and F1 score.
clos.enriched_description: Evaluate medical AI models using accuracy, specificity, predictive value, confidence intervals, ROC curves, thresholds, and F1 score. The outcome includes interpreting model performance correctly in diagnostic settings and applying these evaluation concepts to tasks such as MRI brain tumor auto-segmentation.

clos.original_description: Diagnose diseases from x-rays and 3D MRI brain images.
clos.enriched_description: Diagnose diseases from X-ray and 3D MRI brain images using medical image analysis methods. The scope includes exploring MRI data, image segmentation, extracting sub-sections, implementing U-Net, and applying these techniques to brain tumor auto-segmentation for magnetic resonance imaging.

clos.original_description: Walk through examples of prognostic tasks.
clos.enriched_description: Walk through medical prognostic task examples using linear prognostic models, risk prediction, feature interactions, and prognostic model evaluation. The scope includes creating linear models, working with risk scores using Pandas and NumPy, combining features, and using the concordance index.

clos.original_description: Predict patient survival rates more accurately using tree-based models.
clos.enriched_description: Predict patient survival rates using tree-based and survival modeling methods. The scope includes decision trees, missing-data handling and imputation, survival estimates, time-to-event data, censored data, Kaplan-Meier estimation, survival and hazard functions, individualized risk models, survival trees, Cox proportional hazards, random survival forests, and survival model evaluation.

clos.original_description: Navigate practical challenges in medicine, like missing data.
clos.enriched_description: Navigate practical modeling challenges in medicine, especially missing data, censored survival data, categorical variables, and permissible-pair evaluation. The scope includes identifying missing data, applying masks, using imputation, working with time-to-event and Kaplan-Meier concepts, and understanding hazard functions in survival analysis.

clos.original_description: Estimate treatment effects on patients using data from randomized trials.
clos.enriched_description: Estimate patient treatment effects using data from randomized control trials. The outcome includes average treatment effect, individualized treatment effect, medical data operations with Pandas, model training and tuning with scikit-learn, logistic regression model interpretation, and treatment effect estimation assignments.

clos.original_description: Explore methods to interpret diagnostic and prognostic models.
clos.enriched_description: Explore methods for interpreting diagnostic and prognostic machine learning models in medicine. The scope includes feature importance, individual feature importance, interpretation of deep learning models, permutation-based interpretation, and Grad-CAM for visual explanation.

clos.original_description: Automate the task of labeling medical datasets using natural language processing.
clos.enriched_description: Automate labeling of medical datasets using natural language processing methods. The scope includes medical question answering, automatic labeling, evaluation of automatic labeling, text cleaning, BioC format, the NegBio library, preparing text classification inputs, and natural language entity extraction.
